import pandas as pd
from plotnine import *

q1 = pd.read_csv("Data/q1data.csv")

q1.head()
income life_exp population year country four_regions six_regions eight_regions world_bank_region
0 1910.0 61.0 29200000.0 2010 Afghanistan asia south_asia asia_west South Asia
1 11100.0 78.1 2950000.0 2010 Albania europe europe_central_asia europe_east Europe & Central Asia
2 11100.0 74.7 36000000.0 2010 Algeria africa middle_east_north_africa africa_north Middle East & North Africa
3 46900.0 81.9 84500.0 2010 Andorra europe europe_central_asia europe_west Europe & Central Asia
4 7680.0 60.8 23400000.0 2010 Angola africa sub_saharan_africa africa_sub_saharan Sub-Saharan Africa 
q1_plot = q1.dropna(
    subset=["income", "life_exp", "population", "four_regions"])
plot1 = (ggplot(q1_plot,aes(x="income", y="life_exp", size="population", color="four_regions"))
    + geom_point(alpha=0.7)
    + scale_x_log10()
    + labs(title="Life Expectancy and Income, 2010",
        x="Income per person (log scale)",
        y="Life expectancy (years)",
        color="Region",
        size="Population" )
    + theme_minimal()
)

plot1
plot1_text = (ggplot(q1_plot,aes(
            x="income",
            y="life_exp",
            label="country",
            size="population",
            color="four_regions"
        ))
    + geom_text(alpha=0.6)
    + scale_x_log10()
    + scale_size_continuous(range=(4, 12))
    + labs(
        title="Plot 1 Using Country Labels",
        x="Income per person (log scale)",
        y="Life expectancy (years)",
        color="Region",
        size="Population"
    )
    + theme_minimal()
)

plot1_text

q2 = pd.read_csv("Data/q2data.csv")

def clean_energy(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None

    value = str(value).strip()

    if value.endswith("k"):
        return float(value[:-1]) * 1_000
    elif value.endswith("M"):
        return float(value[:-1]) * 1_000_000
    else:
        return float(value)

q2["energy_clean"] = q2["energy"].apply(clean_energy)

q2_plot = q2.dropna(
    subset=["imports", "exports", "energy_clean", "four_regions"]
)
plot2 = ( ggplot(q2_plot, aes(
         x="imports",
         y="exports",
         size="energy_clean",
        color="four_regions"
        ))
    + geom_point(alpha=0.7)
    + labs( title="Imports, Exports, and Energy Use, 1997",
        x="Imports (% of GDP)",
        y="Exports (% of GDP)",
        color="Region",
        size="Energy use"
    )
    + theme_minimal()
)

plot2
plot2_text = (ggplot(q2_plot,aes(
        x="imports",
         y="exports",
        label="country",
        size="energy_clean",
        color="four_regions" ))
    + geom_text(alpha=0.6)
    + scale_size_continuous(range=(4, 12))
    + labs(
        x="Imports (% of GDP)",
        y="Exports (% of GDP)",
        color="Region",
        size="Energy use"
    )
    + theme_minimal()
)

plot2_text
